member_impact: Employees can locate the correct employer-sponsored program entry point.
evidence: 100/100 synthetic discovery tests routed to the correct employer program.

failure_mode: Employee name and identifier formatting differ between employer eligibility file and enrollment matching rules.
employer_impact: Eligible employees may contact HR/Benefits because the newly launched benefit appears unavailable to them.
member_impact: Eligible employees may receive an ineligible/not-found message during enrollment.
evidence: 13% of synthetic eligibility records failed identity matching; failures cluster around hyphenated names, preferred names, and leading-zero employee IDs.
remediation: Normalize identity fields, validate matching rules, and rerun a representative eligibility test population before production approval.

failure_mode: Enrollment flow contains an unresolved eligibility-group mapping for one employee class.
employer_impact: A subset of employees may require manual escalation during launch week.
member_impact: Employees in one eligibility group may be unable to complete enrollment without support.
evidence: 8/200 synthetic enrollment scenarios failed for the same eligibility-group code.
remediation: Correct group mapping and repeat end-to-end enrollment testing for affected employee class.

member_impact: Opt-in employees can create member accounts successfully.

failure_mode: Employer configuration and contracted benefit rules disagree on which enrolled members qualify for the smart scale.
employer_impact: Employees may receive inconsistent device experiences and the employer may see avoidable complaints about benefit fairness or missing equipment.
member_impact: Some eligible members may receive only the blood-pressure monitor when their benefit configuration should include a smart scale.
evidence: 15% of synthetic entitled-member scenarios returned a device bundle inconsistent with the contracted rule set.
remediation: Reconcile device-entitlement rules, obtain employer approval, and retest all device-eligible population segments.

failure_mode: Address validation rejects apartment/unit formatting in a small subset of test orders.
employer_impact: A small number of launch-week device orders may require manual fulfillment support.
member_impact: Device shipment may be delayed until address information is corrected.
evidence: 6/150 synthetic shipment requests failed address validation.
remediation: Expand address normalization rules and retest common apartment/unit formats.

failure_mode: Two synthetic activation tokens expired before first use.
member_impact: A small number of members may need a new activation link.
remediation: Confirm token expiration messaging and self-service resend path.

failure_mode: Pairing failure rate is elevated on one synthetic mobile OS/device combination.
employer_impact: Increased member-support demand could reduce perceived launch quality.
member_impact: Members may receive a device but be unable to pair it without support.
evidence: 11/160 pairing tests failed, concentrated in one test device profile.
remediation: Validate pairing instructions and support escalation for affected device profile before launch.

failure_mode: Smart-scale readings are accepted by the app but not appearing in the downstream program data feed for one entitlement path.
employer_impact: Engagement reporting may understate usage and the employer may question whether the connected benefit is working as promised.
member_impact: Members may see successful device use while their readings are unavailable to downstream program workflows.
evidence: 24/160 synthetic readings-ingestion tests failed; all failed records share the same smart-scale entitlement path.
remediation: Correct the entitlement-to-data mapping and rerun device-to-reporting validation before launch approval.

failure_mode: Seven synthetic support scenarios do not have a documented owner/escalation route.
employer_impact: Launch escalations may bounce between teams and increase resolution time.
member_impact: Members with pairing, replacement, or sync issues may experience slower resolution.
evidence: 7/80 synthetic support cases lacked a complete escalation path.
remediation: Complete support ownership matrix and validate escalation routing before launch.
